doc: Blind rerun, authored (README rule 7, step 3.5) from holon/rules/fact.py and holon/measures_fact.py. sort_types: the typed-sorts sidecar; documents: its one transitions document. hypotheses: none (the target code names no oracle hypothesis). search: empty, so the FACT search uses its own defaults. measure: the defaults holon.rules.fact.analyse reads when none is given (no fresh word, max_length 0). term_size: none (no term-size budget is fixed by the target code).
